info.title: FatturaFacile ERP API
info.summary: Multi-tenant ERP API for invoicing, purchasing, inventory, banking, accounting and operations.
info.description:
REST API of the FatturaFacile ERP.

Every request except login and the incoming webhooks must carry a bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`) and the organization it works on (`X-Tenant-ID: <uuid>`). Errors follow RFC 9457 (`application/problem+json`).

CategorizeLineRequest.description:
Manual categorisation of a line that is not linked to an invoice. The ledger account defaults to the tenant
preference of the category (taxes, payroll, bank expenses) when omitted.
CategorizeLineRequest.title: CategorizeLineRequest

CreateProductVariantRequest.description:
Manual creation of one variant of a parent product. The SKU is generated from the attributes when omitted and the
price defaults to the parent price.
CreateProductVariantRequest.title: CreateProductVariantRequest

GenerateVariantsMatrixRequest.description: Bulk generation of the variants of a parent product from an attribute matrix.
GenerateVariantsMatrixRequest.title: GenerateVariantsMatrixRequest

ImportBankStatementRequest.description: Upload of a bank statement file: CBI (`.cbi`, `.txt`) or ISO 20022 (`.xml`).
ImportBankStatementRequest.title: ImportBankStatementRequest

ManualMatchRequest.description:
Manual match of a statement line with a document: a customer invoice for an incoming line, a received supplier
invoice for an outgoing one (`invoice_id` accepts both). `difference_handling` says how to treat an amount that
differs from the balance: `none` (only differences within the tolerance), `write_off` or `partial`.
ManualMatchRequest.title: ManualMatchRequest

ReceiveIncomingInvoiceRequest.description: Incoming-invoice webhook: same shared-secret protection as the SDI notification webhook.
ReceiveIncomingInvoiceRequest.title: ReceiveIncomingInvoiceRequest

RestoreUploadRequest.description: Upload of an external backup archive (ZIP) to restore into the current tenant.
RestoreUploadRequest.title: RestoreUploadRequest

StoreProductRequest.description:
Creation of a product. `min_stock` is the reorder threshold watched by the low stock dashboard widget; null means
the product is not monitored.
StoreProductRequest.title: StoreProductRequest

UpdateDashboardLayoutRequest.description:
Replaces the dashboard of the current user: which widgets, where they sit on the 12 column grid and how each one is
configured.
UpdateDashboardLayoutRequest.title: UpdateDashboardLayoutRequest

UpdateProductRequest.description: Update of a product: only the fields sent change. `min_stock` may be set to null to stop monitoring the product.
UpdateProductRequest.title: UpdateProductRequest

UpdateProductVariantRequest.description: Update of one variant. Attributes sent replace the option attributes (size, colour, ...) of the variant.
UpdateProductVariantRequest.title: UpdateProductVariantRequest

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
